method: Every server in the official MCP Registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io, latest version per name) that lists a Streamable HTTP remote URL without template variables was checked once between 2026-11-02T05:59:15.102Z and 2026-11-02T06:00:22.222Z with the open McpStamp Check engine (24 checks over transport, auth discovery, tools and metadata; no credentials sent, max 5 requests per server). Scores, grades and store readiness (Claude Directory, ChatGPT Apps, Gemini Connected Apps, MCP Registry) are exactly the engine's output; averages and grades are over servers that answered, and rows list only those servers.
